digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify and External Integration Tests CI workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently executes thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds of macOS critical path time.
ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; this constraint must be narrowly superseded to move complete corpus replay to an external integration job.

The approved design retains three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) and compact provenance probes in Gerrit Verify, moving full real-Pandoc replay to a dedicated weekly/manual job in external-integration.yml.
The current External Integration workflow is Ubuntu-only and requires a later implementation to add a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay matrix with both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners.
Implementation must obtain paired A/B timing evidence and ensure Pandoc version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints fail fast.
